about_the_game:
Survive The Hunt is an Extraction Horror game for 3 to 16 players where you will play one of these 5 roles:

-Beast: You must kill everyone, except the mercenaries (optional).

-Prisoner: Your objective is to escape from the facility where they have been doing scientific experiments on you to transform you into a beast of the US military complex.

-Scientist: Your goal is to escape not only from the facility, but also from the prisoners you have been doing unethical and very painful scientific experiments on and from the beast you helped to create.

-Police: Your main objective is to help the scientists escape from the facility at all costs, and if you come across a prisoner you must arrest or kill him.

-Mercenary: You have to eliminate all traces of life inside the facility, except the beast, if you don't feel like it...

Be careful with who you cooperate with because, even if they are of the same role, they can stab you in the back.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains explicit violence: blood, gore, corpses and use of weapons to execute other players
